title: Ho Chi Minh City in a day
summary: The cathedral square, Nguyễn Huệ, the Reunification Palace, Bến Thành, the War Remnants Museum, cơm tấm, and Bình Tây in Chợ Lớn.

stops.name: Notre-Dame Cathedral
stops.note: Look at both towers from the square in the morning.

stops.name: Central Post Office
stops.note: Step into the hall opposite the cathedral.

approach.note: Cross to the hall opposite the cathedral.

stops.name: Nguyen Hue
stops.note: Stroll the paving from City Hall to the river. Sundown is the liveliest hour.

approach.note: Walk the paving toward the river.

stops.name: Reunification Palace
stops.note: Walk the halls and the basement, open 07:00–18:00. The palace alone is 40,000 đồng. An adult ticket is also listed at 80,000 đồng.

approach.note: Walk to 135 Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa.

stops.name: Ben Thanh Market
stops.note: Walk the aisles to the food end of the hall.

approach.note: Walk to the market on Quách Thị Trang.

stops.name: War Remnants Museum
stops.note: Walk the courtyard and the galleries, open 7:30–17:30, last admission 17:00. An adult ticket is 60,000 đồng from 1 October 2026, and 15,000 đồng is also listed.

approach.note: Walk to the museum on Võ Văn Tần.

stops.name: Binh Tay Market
stops.note: Walk the clock gate and the trading floor in Chợ Lớn.

additions.name: Thien Hau Pagoda
additions.note: The pagoda pairs with Bình Tây on the Chợ Lớn walk.

seoTitle: Ho Chi Minh City in a day
seoDescription: One day in the city: the center walk, the War Remnants Museum, cơm tấm, and Bình Tây.
